open_science_requirements: Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences common to all fields, including digital ones (e.g. generative AI), and foster Open Science, knowledge valorisation, innovation/entrepreneurship where applicable, and good scientific conduct such as research integrity (CC-10, Scope — Training activities).

Training activities must foster Open Science, knowledge valorisation, and research integrity, and prepare fellows for research collaboration enabled by digital technologies (FAIR data, citizen science, etc.) (SR-06, Scope — Training activities).
